review_candidates.title: Senior Programme Support Associate
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) and in close coordination with Heads of Units, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) Dublin, the Senior Programme Support Associate will be responsible and accountable for supporting the planning, development, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of IOM programmes in Ireland. The role will contribute to programme development, donor engagement, policy analysis, resource mobilisation, partnership-building, and compliance with IOM and donor requirements. The position works closely with programme staff, government counterparts, donors, United Nations (UN) agencies, Civil Society Organisations (CSOs), the Regional Office (RO), and Headquarters (HQ) to support the effective delivery and growth of IOM's programme portfolio. The Senior Programme Support Associate will provide specialised programme support and coordination across multiple projects and thematic areas. The role requires the application of sound knowledge of programme management, migration issues, donor requirements, and results-based management, while exercising initiative and judgement in supporting programme quality, compliance, and strategic growth. Responsibilities Coordinate the implementation of IOM Ireland projects in accordance with IOM policies, donor requirements, budgets, workplans and timelines, contributing to achievement of expected results. Coordinate and analyse programme Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) information, track programme performance results against established indicators and targets, and recommend corrective actions to improveoperational effectiveness and programme quality. Coordinate the preparation of and review donor reports, programme updates, briefing notes, and other related documentation by validating compliance with donor agreements and organisational standards to support accurate and timely programme reporting. Coordinate programme data collection, analysis, and information management processes, maintain accurate records, document lessons learned, and promote knowledge-sharing across programmes. Monitor, analyse, and report on migration trends, and emerging priorities in Ireland, preparing technical inputs that support programme planning, operational positioning, and funding opportunities. Contribute to the design and development of programmes, project proposals, concept notes, and funding applications by consolidating technical inputs and assessing alignment with IOM priorities, government needs, and donor requirements. Identify funding opportunities, analyse donor priorities, support donor engagement efforts, and contribute to resource mobilisation strategies aimed at expanding and diversifying the IOM Ireland funding portfolio. Maintain effective working relationships with donor counterparts, government authorities, diplomatic missions, Implementing Partners (IPs), and other relevant institutions to facilitate successful programme implementation and development. Support the preparation of communication and visibility materials, coordinate donor visits and briefings, and contribute to staff capacity-building initiatives related to programme development, reporting, and results-based management. Participate in relevant inter-agency forums, technical working groups, conferences, and meetings with government counterparts, donors, UN agencies, CSOs, and other stakeholders to strengthen partnerships and promote IOM priorities. Undertake duty travel as required, within the scope of the position, contributing to the effective delivery of programme support services and operational requirements. Perform such other relevant duties as maybe assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, International Development, Political or Social Sciences, Migration Studies, Law, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or, High School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in project development and project management, humanitarian and migration-related activities, complex project implementation, budget drafting, research, report writing, liaison with governments and international agencies; Experience with project planning, scheduling and deployment of resources, and evaluation and assessment; Experience in liaising with government authorities, national/international institutions and donors. Experience in supporting results-based project development and reporting, technical writing and editing, preferably in the international development/humanitarian sector; Work experience in donor relations and grant management for specific donors of IOM’s interest; Experience in working with international culturally diverse teams; Confirmed experience in donor report writing in humanitarian and/or development settings; and, Experience with Results Based Management approach and other strategic planning approaches. Skills Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation tools and protocols. Strong interpersonal & intercultural skills with an attention to detail. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.description: 关于公司 美世乐（MUST ENERGY GROUP）专注于 新能源与清洁能源解决方案 ，核心业务涵盖光伏组件、储能系统、逆变器等产品，致力于为全球客户提供可靠、耐用的新能源产品与解决方案。 随着海外业务持续发展，公司正在加快全球市场布局，持续拓展 非洲、欧洲等重点区域市场 ，并逐步完善本地化销售与服务体系。 关于职位 我们正在招聘 海外销售总监 ，负责非洲/欧洲区域的市场拓展与业务经营。 该岗位不仅负责销售业绩，更将承担区域市场的 业务规划、渠道体系建设、重点客户与项目开发、销售团队搭建及管理 等职责。你将深度参与区域市场策略制定，并推动业务从市场机会识别到项目落地，实现持续增长。 我们期待寻找一 具备新能源行业及海外市场经验、能够独立开拓区域市场并带领团队实现业务增长 的销售管理者。 工作职责 负责非洲或欧洲区域新能源产品(光伏组件、储能系统、逆变器等)的市场开拓、客户维护及销售目标达成。 挖掘潜在客户(如经销商、EPC承包商、能源署)，推广离网微电网、分布式能源等解决方案。 主导项目投标、合同谈判、回款跟踪及售后服务协调，确保订单交付与客户满意度。 收集非洲或欧洲市场政策动态(如清关规则、可再生能源补贴)、竞争对手信息及客户需求，优化销售策略。 组建当地销售团队，管理日常运营及客户关系维护;协调技术、售后部门提供本地化方案支持。 代表公司参加非洲/欧洲区域行业展会，提升品牌影响力。 任职资格 本科及以上学历，英语流利，掌握法语更佳。 5年以上新能源行业(光伏、储能)外贸销售经验，具备非洲/欧洲市场成功开发案例。 熟悉非洲或欧洲各国清关税务政策、招投标流程及国际认证标准(IEC/UL). 熟悉非洲或欧洲离网微电网、户用储能等新兴机会，具备渠道资源整合能力。 跨文化沟通:擅长与当地业主、总包商建立信任，解决突发问题。 能接受非洲（前期西北非）或欧洲（波兰）驻外工作。

review_candidates.title: 驻外网约车财务经理
review_candidates.company: 广州倬亿贸易有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 驻海外财务经理： 1.协助总部财务管理当地财务团队，编写财务团队各岗位职责、考核要求指标，具体团队管理能力； 2.协助部门负责人拟定公司的经营目标，并跟进目标管理。负责各主体公司预算的汇总、编制、监督、控制、差异分析； 3.协助设定财务年度工作目标、月度工作计划和年度预算编制、汇总并上报，经批准后执行； 4.有效组织会计核算、财务监督和财务管理工作的开展；按要求定期生成财务报表（如利润表、资产负债表），确保核算准确、及时。充分考虑境内外准则差异，出具本地报表及调整项。 5.参与公司的财务分析、项目可行性研究分析、银行关系维护、融资方案设计等工作； 6.协助建立税务知识文库，结合尼日利亚当地税务要求，指导税务同事输出标准操作文件； 7.协同监督税务数据极端、申报及缴纳流程，确保税务合规； 8.参与定价策略制定、新业务线（如拼车、租车）的财务模型搭建，评估盈利潜力； 9.负责外资投资企业税务政策的收集，负责税务政策优惠的申请； 10.完成上级交办的其他工作任务，并做好与相关部门的配合和协调工作。 任职要求： 1. 熟悉全盘账务处理。 2. 5-10年财务工作经验，5年以上团队管理经验、财务管理经验, 汽车、互联网、制造业经验优先。 3. 熟悉各类办公软件、财务系统。 4. 较强的判断与数据分析能力、沟通能力。 5. 英语流利，可出差或者长驻尼日利亚。

review_candidates.title: 网络管理部管培生
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 一、岗位职责 1. 网络规划支持： 协助上级收集、整理与分析周边市场与竞争对手数据，参与制定经销商网络发展策略。 2. 经销商开发： 参与潜在经销商的寻源、初步接洽与资质评估工作，支持新网点的建店流程与验收。 3. 经销商关系维护：协助传达公司政策、产品信息与商务支持，并收集反馈。 4. 运营支持： 协助监控现有经销商的运营表现（如销售、售后、客户满意度等），参与准备定期运营分析报告。 5. 市场活动协助： 协同经销商与市场部门，支持区域性市场推广与品牌体验活动的落地执行。 二、核心任职要求 1. 2024/2025届应届毕业生，本科及以上学历，俄语专业或精通俄语的复合专业背景者优先。 2. 俄语水平达到C1及以上标准，口语流利，能作为工作语言进行深度商务沟通。 3. 具备出色的跨文化沟通能力、学习能力和抗压能力，能适应快节奏的海外工作环境。 4. 对企业管理有浓厚兴趣，有志于在汽车行业的销售与服务领域长期发展。 5. 熟练掌握Office办公软件。

review_candidates.title: 经营总监（新能源）
review_candidates.company: 北京协合运维风电技术有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1、战略规划与经营闭环：牵头制定公司中长期战略规划与年度经营计划，推动核心管理层达成共识；建立经营绩效闭环体系，从目标设定、过程追踪、偏差预警到纠偏行动，确保战略目标穿透到区域执行层而非停留在总部报表。 2、经营洞察与决策影响：构建并持续迭代公司级经营分析框架，使其成为管理层决策基础设施；定期从财务、市场、运营等维度穿透数据，主动识别结构性机会与风险，用数据和洞察影响核心层决策方向。 3、区域管控与运营机制重塑：主导优化预算管理、成本管控、项目管理及供应商管理等关键运营机制；定期下沉区域验证总部制度在一线的执行效果，识别问题，打通总部与区域的经营数据及业务闭环。 4、组织绩效与经营联动：主导公司级绩效评价流程设计与运行，推动绩效结果与经营成果深度联动；设计或优化与经营指标挂钩的激励方案，识别低绩效根因并推动组织行为改善，激发组织活力。 任职要求： 1、本科及以上学历，企业管理、财务、经济、工程管理或电力相关专业。MBA或相关管理硕士优先。 2、10年以上工作经验，其中5年以上经营管理、战略运营、综合管理或高级业务分析经验，至少3年以上团队经验。具备电力、能源、大型基础设施或技术运维服务行业经验者优先。 3、独立操盘过P&L，或完整主导过一次跨部门战略级变革项目，有可验证的落地结果。 4、具备商业洞察力、系统思维与结构化解决问题能力；强大的跨部门沟通、协调与影响力；高度的责任心、结果导向和抗压能力；能下沉一线推动执行，而非只在总部做分析。
